what: Etsy's seller policy states "Etsy is a unique marketplace" where "buyers come here to purchase items that they might not find anywhere else," requiring all items to be "made, designed, handpicked, or sourced by a seller."
verbatim_snippet: "Etsy is a unique marketplace. Buyers come here to purchase items that they might not find anywhere else, or to spark their own creativity. As such, everything listed for sale on Etsy must be made, designed, handpicked, or sourced by a seller."
notes: Verbatim recovered from search index snippet; page not directly fetched. The phrase "items that they might not find anywhere else" and the restriction to maker/curator-sourced goods positions the marketplace as distinct from general e-commerce. Self-positioning sub-type (SD-05).
